jobs.prompt: Create a photorealistic contemporary apartment dining room adapted as a tabletop robot manipulation workspace. Center a matte oak worktable with a clear near-side robot aisle. Place a red sorting block beside a shallow blue tray, an upright blue ceramic cup, a natural wood push block beside a flat green goal pad, and a stable three-block stack, all separately visible and reachable. Add a far-wall sideboard, compact charging dock, window, restrained wall art, diffuse daylight, and warm pendant lighting. Keep every task unsolved, every push corridor clear, and one fixed near-left oblique camera view unobstructed. Do not include glass furniture, mirrors, text, exposed cables, random clutter, floating objects, intersections, or a robot baked into SceneCode geometry.
